name: translate-ter
description: Local-first desktop workflow for transcription, subtitle editing, and translation.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p tsconfig.web.json && electron-vite build
scripts.native:configure: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$cmake='C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\18\Community\Common7\IDE\CommonExtensions\Microsoft\CMake\CMake\bin\cmake.exe'; if (!(Test-Path $cmake)) { $cmake='cmake' }; & $cmake -S . -B build/native"
scripts.native:build: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$cmake='C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\18\Community\Common7\IDE\CommonExtensions\Microsoft\CMake\CMake\bin\cmake.exe'; if (!(Test-Path $cmake)) { $cmake='cmake' }; & $cmake --build build/native --config Release"
